findings.description: Regions 5 & 7 (identity dark/light mobile): in the top-left streak card, the 'day streak' caption is centered horizontally while the flame icon and '205' value are left-aligned, creating a slight visual offset between the metric and its label.

Regions 6 & 8 (activity-map dark/light mobile): the header observation timestamp omits the middle dot between date and time ('Nov 24 09:00 JST') compared to 'Nov 24 · 09:00 JST' on desktop (regions 2 & 4) and 'Nov 24 · 22:46 JST' on identity bands (regions 1, 3, 5, 7).

verdict.summary: Approved with zero blockers across all 8 regions (desktop and mobile, dark and light). All five round-2 fixes are verified: the 72h timeline 'now' edge is accurately anchored to the snapshot observation time (Nov 24 09:00 JST, matching the ~6h gap to the newest listed event at 02:46 JST with no false empty tail); PR squares follow monotonic ceil(prs/100) capped at 4 so '+22/+24 more public' aggregates no longer visually outrank higher-PR repos; commit dots on dim/aggregate rows are clearly legible in both dark and light desktop themes; mobile IN PROGRESS rows display enlarged, legible tier pips matching the footer legend; and mobile CONTRIBUTED TO includes the total count ('· 28') with an exact '+1 over' overflow indicator (27 dots + 1). All M1-M7 criteria are satisfied with strong glanceability, honest encodings, and clean legibility at README scale.
